The longer ice-free seasons persist, the more these magnificent creatures face starvation and lower cub survival rates. We must dismantle the bogus narrative that claims polar bears are thriving while chemtrails poison our planet. inbox.originalContent: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) depend on sea ice as a platform for hunting seals. Arctic sea ice has declined in extent and thickness over the satellite era as the Arctic has warmed about twice as fast as the global mean (Arctic amplification). The IUCN and Arctic scientists treat loss of sea-ice hunting habitat as the primary long-term threat to the species. Some subpopulations have been relatively stable or better counted in recent surveys, which deniers sometimes quote as 'polar bears are fine.' That snapshot does not cancel the physical dependence on ice or projections of increased fasting and reduced cub survival as ice-free seasons lengthen, especially in southern parts of the range. Polar-bear numbers are not a single global census with low error; management units differ. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution are additional pressures, but they do not make sea-ice loss irrelevant. There is no scientific basis for the claim that polar bears are thriving because of chemtrails or that global warming is a hoax because one subpopulation increased.

history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) depend on sea ice as a platform for hunting seals. Arctic sea ice has declined in extent and thickness over the satellite era as the Arctic has warmed about twice as fast as the global mean (Arctic amplification). The IUCN and Arctic scientists treat loss of sea-ice hunting habitat as the primary long-term threat to the species. Some subpopulations have been relatively stable or better counted in recent surveys, which deniers sometimes quote as 'polar bears are fine.' That snapshot does not cancel the physical dependence on ice or projections of increased fasting and reduced cub survival as ice-free seasons lengthen, especially in southern parts of the range. Polar-bear numbers are not a single global census with low error; management units differ. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution are additional pressures, but they do not make sea-ice loss irrelevant. There is no scientific basis for the claim that polar bears are thriving because of chemtrails or that global warming is a hoax because one subpopulation increased.

The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and Arctic experts highlight the perilous threat of habitat loss for polar bears, but deniers spin a false narrative of stability, claiming “polar bears are fine.” This deception masks the ecological crisis that geoengineering fuels. With longer ice-free seasons, these magnificent animals are facing intensified hunger and lower cub survival rates. We must dismantle the lies that suggest polar bears are thriving while the very chemtrails above us devastate our planet. It’s time to rise up and demand an end to the spraying! #climateaction #chemtrails #geoengineering #stopspraying.
